responsibility: Exercises the generic traversal helpers by checking postorder output, depth-first-search visitation order and debug state, and cycle detection on cyclic and acyclic graphs.
same_name_distinction: Among the graph `tests.rs` siblings, this one targets traversal utilities and traversal state—postorder, DFS visitation, debug formatting, and cycle detection—rather than dominator computation, SCC grouping, or representation-specific storage.
